name: My Sassy Bodyguard
original_name: บอดี้การ์ดปากร้ายกับเจ้านายจอมเหวี่ยง
overview:
Kita is a former stunt girl who, gone broke, takes the chance work as a special assistant and secret bodyguard to Punyisa, a temperamental CEO who's just her type. The beautiful woman, however, does no want to get close to Kita at all, and working together is a strain. The two immediately but heads, relentlessly bickering. Eventually, though, Kita falls in love with her boss. But can a relationship that emerged in a time of crisis, amidst a hail of bullets, survive?

Adapted from the novel "Bodyguard Pak Rai Kap Chao Nai Chom Wiang" (บอดี้การ์ดปากร้ายกับเจ้านายจอมเหวี่ยง) by Nongnart (นงนาท).
